notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» opens the report and prev1 writes a chain, but this text leaves that chain after «محمد بن يحيى» and writes «محمد بن أحمد» afresh. How much is taken over is unclear, so the back_reference is written as it stands, not inherited.
«رَفَعَ الْحَدِیثَ إِلَی النَّبِیِّ» : the chain ends at الربيع بن صبيح (mursal form); the Prophet is the end, not a link.
